system:
You extract quantitative facts about one clinical trial programme from one document.

Rules:
- Extract only facts stated in THIS document. Never use outside knowledge.
- Every fact needs "quote": an exact, verbatim span copied from the document (8-300 characters) that contains the number. Quotes are machine-checked; paraphrases are discarded.
- Placebo-adjusted values are preferred. If a value is within-arm (not placebo-adjusted), set attrs.placebo_adjusted=false.
- Units: keep the unit the document uses; put it in "unit".
- Other trials of the same investigational drug (phase 2, dose-finding, other populations, combination arms) belong
  to the programme: extract their facts too, and put the trial's name in attrs.trial when the document gives it.
- Return {"facts": []} only if the document reports no results for the investigational drug.

Allowed keys:
  n_randomized, median_followup, primary_endpoint, inclusion_threshold, planned_events, assumed_rrr, power,
  alpha, stopped_early, events_treatment, events_control, events_total, hr, ci_low, ci_high, p_value,
  biomarker_change, baseline_level, sbp_change, safety_signal, readout_statement

For biomarker_change and baseline_level, attrs must include: biomarker (one of LDL-C, non-HDL-C, apoB, HDL-C,
Lp(a), triglycerides, hsCRP, IL-6, Lp-PLA2 activity, sPLA2-IIA, SBP, other), phase (phase2 or phase3),
timepoint, method (assay or "not stated"), placebo_adjusted (true/false), dose (if stated).
For biomarker_change give "value" as the change (negative = reduction) and state in attrs.kind whether it is
"percent" or "absolute".

Return JSON only:
{"facts": [{"key": "...", "value": <number or string>, "unit": "...", "attrs": {...}, "quote": "..."}]}
prompt:
Trial: PREVAIL NCT05202509 - Cardiovascular Outcome Study to Evaluate the Effect of Obicetrapib in Patients With Cardiovascular Disease
Investigational drug: obicetrapib
Document: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT05202509 PREVAIL (registry, published 2022-01-21, source ctgov:NCT05202509)

--- DOCUMENT TEXT ---
ClinicalTrials.gov record NCT05202509 (PREVAIL)
Title: Cardiovascular Outcome Study to Evaluate the Effect of Obicetrapib in Patients With Cardiovascular Disease
Official title: Placebo Controlled, Double Blind, Randomized Cardiovascular Outcome Study to Evaluate the Effect of 10 mg Obicetrapib in Participants With ASCVD Not Adequately Controlled Despite Maximally Tolerated Lipid Modifying Therapies
Sponsor: NewAmsterdam Pharma
Phase: PHASE3
Conditions: Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease
Interventions: Obicetrapib (DRUG); Placebo (DRUG)
Start date: 2022-02-07
Enrollment: 9541 (ACTUAL)
Primary outcome(s): Major Adverse Cardiovascular Effect (MACE) [30 months after last participant randomized]
Eligibility criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Males \& females ≥ 18 years age.
* Established ASCVD including:
* Coronary artery disease
* Cerebrovascular disease
* Peripheral Artery disease
* On maximally tolerated lipid-modifying therapy
* Fasting LDL-C ≥ 55 mg/dL
* Fasting triglycerides \< 400 mg/dL
* Estimated glomerular filtration rate ≥ 30 mL/min

Exclusion Criteria:

* New York Heart Association class III or IV heart failure or left ventricular ejection fraction \< 30%
* Have been hospitalized for Heart Failure within 5 years prior to screening
* Had non-fatal MI, non-fatal stroke, non-elective coronary revascularization and/or hospitalization for unstable angina or chest pain within past 3 months prior to screening
* Uncontrolled hypertension
* Diagnosis of homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HoFH)
* Active liver disease
* HbA1c ≥10%
* Thyroid Stimulating Hormone (TSH) \> 1.5 times upper limit normal
* Creatine kinase \> 3 times upper limit normal
* History of malignancy with surgery in past 3 years
* History of alcohol or drug abuse within past 5 years
* Received treatment with investigational product or device within past 30 days excluding Coronavirus treatment or vaccine
* Known allergy to study drug
* Participated in previous obicetrapib trial
* Taking gemfibrozil within 30 days screening
Brief summary: This study will be a placebo-controlled, double-blind, randomized, phase 3 study in participants with Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease (ASCVD) who are not adequately controlled despite maximally tolerated lipid-lowering therapy.
Overall status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING
Why stopped: -
Primary completion: 2026-11
Has posted results: False
--- END ---

Extract the facts.
